sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host New Mills at Hind Heath Road on Tuesday 11 August (KO 19:45) in a crucial clash between two mid-table sides both on 6 points. The Bach will be looking to bounce back after their disappointing 3-2 midweek defeat at Foley Meir, while New Mills showed resilience with a late winner against Allscott Heath on Saturday. Both teams have created plenty of chances this season but struggled with clinical finishing, so this promises to be a tight, competitive encounter.
divisionWide: The division features several intriguing matchups on Tuesday evening. AFC Bridgnorth, the in-form second-placed side (W2 D0 L0), travel to Wednesfield Community who have picked up back-to-back wins; this is the standout fixture of the round. Crewe face Foley Meir in a 20:00 KO featuring two teams searching for consistency after mixed starts. Alsager Town host struggling Stafford Town, who despite their strong league position have now lost twice in four games following Saturday's defeat to Sandbach. Market Drayton visit Telford Town in a derby clash between two teams looking to climb the table. Allscott Heath welcome local rivals Shawbury United in another derby. Wolverhampton Casuals' perfect record will be tested at home against struggling Eccleshall, who sit just outside the top four despite recent inconsistency.
